snippet.title: Arrowdle: Arrows Escape Puzzle — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Arrowdle is an arrow puzzle with a new challenge every day. Tap an arrow and it slides off the board along its path; if it hits another arrow, you lose a heart. Find the right order and clear the board.

In this video:
0:00 Arrowdle
0:04 Daily challenge
0:10 Watch out for crashes
0:15 Frozen arrows
0:21 Lock and key
0:26 Deflectors
0:32 Twin arrows
0:37 Fog
0:43 Bomb arrow
0:49 Time attack
0:55 Daily streak
1:02 Endless levels

Download it free on Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mskapps.arrowdle

Website: https://msk.com.uy/apps/arrowdle/

#Arrowdle #ArrowPuzzle #LogicGames
